resume_protocol: Fetch latest main SHA and verify whether main moved from the recorded base.
Fetch PR metadata, exact head SHA, changed files/diff, CI status, and this checkpoint before editing.
Treat only committed code with passing tests as completed; never infer completion from chat history.
If main moved, compare and reconcile explicitly; never force-reset or overwrite unverified work.
Keep all v0.4.0 functional changes on this branch until release gate passes.
Never reintroduce broad subtree:true MutationObserver patterns or documentElement-wide observers.
After this checkpoint commit, do not change functional code unless final-head CI or release audit finds a concrete defect.
product_principle: 首页10秒回答：孩子现在在哪 -> 最近有没有变化 -> 变化来自哪里；再进入具体考试/分数。学生不被审判，家长知道要看什么，老师能快速读懂分享。

implementation.strategy: Keep the v0.3 API/KV/data contract intact and place one final v0.4 UI coordinator/design-token layer after the proven v2/v3 modules. Hide duplicated legacy overview output, bound all asynchronous enhancement waits, and avoid broad DOM observation.
implementation.intentional_boundary: The sharing/privacy workflow remains a top-level main tab instead of being duplicated as a settings tile. Settings task navigation covers children, family members, independent-family invitations, and account recovery.
implementation.weak_network_boundary: The coordinator still waits for existing data-driven renderers where necessary, but legacy duplicates are suppressed once v0.4 data is available; there is no continuous mutation loop or subtree observer, and exam entry is not blocked by the v0.4 overview fetch.

S0.name: UI baseline and recovery contract
evidence: Draft PR #13 created from main 9dab7d1d3ff8a03db24163f113dcb5bed98ac105.
This checkpoint is the authoritative interruption-recovery source.
main re-verified unchanged immediately before sealing release checkpoint.

S1.name: Design-system consolidation
evidence: ui-v040.css defines radius-sm=10px, radius-md=14px, radius-lg=20px, spacing rhythm and two shadow levels.
Common focus-visible treatment added; restrained existing green/neutral palette retained.
Academic direction is expressed with text/arrows rather than red/green value judgment.

S2.name: Homepage hierarchy
evidence: v4-overview has exactly three primary zones: 现在在哪 / 最近变化 / 变化来自哪里.
School-relative position is the largest visual datum; total score is supporting context only.
Legacy hero and old six-subject summary are suppressed after the consolidated overview mounts.

S3.name: Trajectory information architecture
evidence: Detailed v3 trajectory is moved under native 深入看轨迹 disclosure and its duplicate overall summary is hidden.
Mobile six-subject display is compact row scanning rather than six oversized cards.
Single-subject history and category-gated trend logic from v0.3 remain intact.

S4.name: Human exam-entry semantics
evidence: comparisonLevel is presented as 考试范围（可选）.
comparisonSeries is moved behind 更多比较信息（可选） as 属于同一个考试系列（可选）.
联考位次/人数 use the existing saved input names and are moved into overall position; fields are visible/enabled only for joint exams.
Existing exam-humanize subject-card structure and save contract are unchanged.

S5.name: Sharing flow redesign
evidence: Primary private sharing flow is 分享什么 -> 给谁看 -> 隐私摘要 -> 生成并复制链接.
Audience presets: 家人 / 老师 / 自定义; advanced fields/mode/expiry are secondary native-details content.
Public homepage creation is moved to an explicit advanced disclosure.
Duplicate legacy teacher preset is hidden once v0.4 sharing is active; family notes/account/member data remain outside share output.

S6.name: Settings/onboarding simplification
evidence: Settings gains task navigation for 孩子资料 / 家庭成员 / 邀请新家庭 / 账号与恢复; 分享与隐私 intentionally remains a top-level main tab.
Independent-family acceptance is staged into 建立家庭 -> 创建登录账号 -> 孩子资料.
Recovery-code completion requires an explicit 已保存 checkbox before continuing.

S7.name: Renderer consolidation and weak-network behavior
evidence: One final ui-v040 coordinator replaces additional feature-specific patches for this release and is loaded last.
Only top-level or short-lived local childList observers are used; no subtree:true and no documentElement observer.
All local waiting observers disconnect after 2500ms; no continuous exam-dialog mutation loop is introduced.
v0.3 API/KV, draft recovery and exam save contracts are unchanged.

S8.name: Cross-device and accessibility acceptance
evidence: v040 UI contract covers 620px/380px responsive breakpoints and hover:none touch targets >=44px.
Desktop overview is capped at three primary information zones.
Mobile overview stacks to one column; six-subject scan becomes compact rows; settings/onboarding collapse responsively.
Keyboard focus-visible states cover form fields, buttons, disclosures, source rows and navigation tiles.
